source: Salgado et al. 2017, Scientific Reports 7: 42778 (Isaberrysaura mollensis), Fig. 4: time-calibrated strict consensus of ornithischian relationships against a Triassic-Cretaceous timescale header, with a black bar or oval for each tip's range and Bremer/bootstrap values at a few nodes; rectangular, root left. Image: census 2 figure (1210x1036 px), the embedded raster.
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names without 'gen. et sp. nov.' after Isaberrysaura mollensis (printed in bold); 'Othnieliosaurus' as printed; the clade tips Heterodontosauridae, Ankylosauria, Stegosauria, Marginocephalia and Iguanodontia as printed
gold_note: Ornithischian time tree, read by eye. Three polytomies: the eight branches off the node above Pisanosaurus, Ornithopoda (three), and the ten-branch node holding Hypsilophodon to the Marginocephalia group; the node joining Talenkauen, (Parksosaurus, Gasparinisaura) and Iguanodontia is three-way. Ornithischia, Thyreophora, Neornithischia and Ornithopoda label nodes and are kept. The range bars and ovals are not branches. 29 tips, 4 polytomies (8, 3, 10, 3 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 8 case (census 2, seed 20261251). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
region_note: the tree, below the timescale header (y < 95)
